outcome: Lipid levels (TC, LDL-C, HDL-C, Apo A1, Apo B)
cohort: Women who delivered babies at Shanghai General Hospital between March 2019 and December 2019
finding: Thyroid function in early pregnancy is associated with dyslipidemia and adverse pregnancy outcomes, including increased risk of caesarean section, GDM, preeclampsia, and hypertriglyceridemia.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean sections was higher in women with hypothyroxinemia (HIA) and hypothyroidism than in women with euthyroidism.
